4312.d: Brimhaven is a pirate town located in north-western Karamja and is only accessible to members.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Brimhaven is located immediately north of the Karamja lodestone.
• Brimhaven has a ship ride that will take the player to Ardougne for the low price of 30 coins. This ship is located in the northern part of Brimhaven. The price is lowered to 15 coins after completing the Easy Karamja achievements. Wearing a Ring of charos (a) will allow you to travel to and from Brimhaven for free.
• The charter ships also dock in the Brimhaven Harbour. They provide rides to several other locations, for a fee.
• If you have completed the Shilo Village quest, then Hajedy will take you for a ride in his cart to Shilo Village for the fee of 10-200 coins.
• The House Teleport spell can be used if player-owned house is in Brimhaven. If the Love Story quest has been completed, players can use a Brimhaven tablet (made from a chipped Teleport to House tablet) to teleport to the Brimhaven house portal, even if their house is located elsewhere.
• The amulet of glory teleport to Musa Point, east of Brimhaven.
• If the Holy Grail and A Fairy Tale Part II quests are completed, the Fisher Realm can be reached through the fairy ring system by using code BJR. Use the magic whistle, found at the northwest corner of the Fisher Realm, to exit the Fisher Realm and end up on the northwestern peninsula near the gold mine and Brimhaven.
• Go through the Spirit tree network by a planted Spirit Tree with 83 Farming on the Spirit Tree Patch north-east of the Brimhaven.

4313.d: The Brimhaven Agility Arena is a minigame that features an obstacle course for training Agility.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Teleport to Karamja via the Karamja lodestone.
• Taking the boat from Port Sarim to Karamja and walk.
• Use an Amulet of glory to teleport to Musa Point and walk.
• Take a boat from East Ardougne (30 coins) to Brimhaven.
• Use your Ardougne cloak 1 to teleport to the monastery and run northeast to the boat.
• Activate Karamja gloves 3 and take Hajedy's carts (10 coins) to Brimhaven.
• Move your house to Brimhaven and walk.
• Via fairy ring to the Fisher Realm (code BJR), blow the magic whistle to transport to Brimhaven (requires completion of the Holy Grail quest).
• Use a Brimhaven tablet made from a Teleport to house tablet (requires completion of the Love Story quest and level 77 Magic).
• Via Spirit trees, if you have planted one in Brimhaven.
• Use your TokKul-Zo ring to teleport to TzHaar City, then walk.

4314.d: The Brimhaven Dungeon is an area of Dragonkin ruins located south-west of Brimhaven on the member's portion of the island of Karamja.

4315.d: The Brimhaven Dungeon resource dungeon is a resource dungeon found in the room with iron and steel dragons in the Brimhaven Dungeon.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The fastest way to travel is to use metallic dragon trinkets to teleport to iron dragons (Brimhaven dungeon), placing you one tile away from the resource dungeon. 

Otherwise players will need 875 coins to enter the Brimhaven Dungeon, unless they have completed the hard Karamja achievements, which will grant free access. A hatchet is required to chop through the roots along the way. The hatchet in your tool belt will work. The resource dungeon can also be accessed via a charged hoardstalker ring or a Dungeoneering cape. 

The resource dungeon is at the end of the dungeon, within the room featuring iron and steel dragons.

4321.d: The Brine Rat Cavern is a series of caverns which feature heavily in Olaf's Quest, and cannot be accessed beforehand.
4321.loc: Southeast of the Rellekka Hunter area

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text: The Brine Rat Cavern is in the north-eastern region of the Fremennik Province. There are multiple ways to travel to the cavern. One of the quickest ways is to use the fairy ring, code DKS. Alternatively, a player may use the Fremennik Province lodestone and run northeast. Mask or helm of the Frozen Wyrm twice a day to teleport into the Ice strykewyrm cave. From there, exit the cave and you will emerge close to the windswept tree.
